svg.aria-label: A copying pantograph on a bench. On the right, four templates stand on a bed: three modules of the real codebase and the grilled brief on its plinth. A stylus runs round each template's walls and the linkage moves a pen, at half scale, round the same outline on the card beneath it. After each card the stylus runs one groove of an index plate and the pen writes that line on the overview card. Where one module has an edge the stylus cannot follow, the pen lifts and a flag goes up instead of a line.
